title: API Rate Limiting Implementation
summary: Rate limiting protects APIs from abuse and ensures fair usage via algorithms and response headers.

content.overview: Rate limiting controls the number of requests a client can make in a given time window.
content.details: Implementation algorithms: Token bucket, fixed window counters, sliding window logs. Standard response headers: X-RateLimit-Limit (max allowed), X-RateLimit-Remaining (left), X-RateLimit-Reset (time of reset).
content.caveats: Choose algorithm based on burst handling requirements; token bucket allows bursts, fixed window may suffer from boundary issues.
